## Overall Trend
The data was matched up seamlessly via normalizing the collection codes and tracking extraction distributions over time. 

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go

df = pd.read_csv('results/Gen_alg_summary.csv')
df['Collection_Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Collection_Date'])

# Create an interactive responsive line timeline grouping by date to show the mean and std
df_grouped = df.groupby('Collection_Date')['Detections'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
df_grouped['upper'] = df_grouped['mean'] + df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)
df_grouped['lower'] = df_grouped['mean'] - df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)

fig = go.Figure()

# Add lower and upper bound with a filled polynomial polygon
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_grouped['Collection_Date'].tolist() + df_grouped['Collection_Date'].tolist()[::-1],
    y=df_grouped['upper'].tolist() + df_grouped['lower'].tolist()[::-1],
    fill='toself',
    fillcolor='rgba(0,100,255,0.2)',
    line=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0)'),
    hoverinfo="skip",
    showlegend=False
))

# Add mean line
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_grouped['Collection_Date'],
    y=df_grouped['mean'],
    mode='lines+markers',
    name='Average',
    line=dict(color='blue')
))

fig.update_layout(
    title='Average Pollen Detections Over Collection Dates (with Variance Polygon)',
    xaxis_title='Date of Collection',
    yaxis_title='Average Pollen Count',
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True
)
fig.show()
```

## Specimen Distribution

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

fig2 = px.box(df, x='Collection_Date', y='Detections', points="all",
              title='Pollen Detections Variance Per Collection Date',
              hover_data=['kod kytky + datum', 'Original_File'])
fig2.update_layout(xaxis_title='Date of Collection', yaxis_title='Pollen Count',
                   margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True)
fig2.show()
```

## Detailed Metrics Array

```{python}
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Select a subset of highly relevant columns for presentation
df_display = df[['kod kytky + datum', 'Collection_Date', 'Detections', 'barvivo [μl]', 'na sklíčko [μ]']].copy()
df_display['Collection_Date'] = df_display['Collection_Date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
df_display.rename(columns={'kod kytky + datum': 'Excel Sample Code'}, inplace=True)

display(HTML(df_display.to_html(classes='table table-striped table-hover', index=False)))
```
